protocol.depth_source_for_metrics_and_PLY: Saved single-channel uint16 PNG decoded as camera Z metres by dividing by1000; no float-depth substitution
protocol.primary_CDE_validity: First-hit ID >=0 AND raw depth positive and finite; verified identical to saved PNG/mask; no alpha50 cutoff
protocol.alpha50_policy: C/D/E depth_mask_alpha50 is primary mask AND accumulated float alpha>=0.5; A primary depth already alpha50; B occupied pixels are retained (no alpha model). first_alpha is single-contributor alpha and is NOT accumulated alpha.
protocol.qmin_gt9_policy: Retained by actual first-contributor raypeak logic, with entry_z=exit_z=0; no finite 3-sigma ellipsoid intersection. Counts and first_alpha distributions are reported separately, never silently gated out.
protocol.PLY_storage: float32 XYZ, uint8 RGB sampled from matching saved RGB PNG; new C/D/E each10 views plus unfiltered merged file
protocol.NN: Exact one-sided Euclidean nearest neighbour from float32 exported/backprojected points to all7004696 original no-glass source points; no ICP
protocol.mesh_reference: Unchanged v007 no-glass first-hit camera-Z float32 arrays, near0.2m and unnormalized rays already independently audited; no mesh used to filter exported points
protocol.own_valid_domain: method primary validity AND mesh first-hit validity for Z errors; NN uses every primary valid point
protocol.common_all5_domain: All five primary depth masks AND mesh reference validity, identical across methods
protocol.common_all5_alpha50_domain: All five alpha50 eligibility masks AND mesh reference validity, identical across methods
protocol.interior_boundary: Reuse fixed v0073x3 mesh-depth discontinuity masks; both own-domain and matched all-five slices reported
protocol.aggregation: Pool eligible pixels/points over10 views; unequal coverage is not hidden by per-view means
protocol.metric_precision: Float64 metric computation and saved error arrays; NN queries use float32 PLY coordinates and float64 source cloud
protocol.error_array_invalid: NaN outside the stated eligible domain; all evaluated values must be finite
protocol.representative_selection: Fixed before v008 results; v007 B coverage spans a broad range; no v008 result-based selection
limitations: NN proximity to any source surface cannot establish visibility, completeness, or correct first-hit ordering; B is structurally favored because it selects original samples.
Own-valid scores have different support; all-five common scores and coverage must be read together.
The common domain is restricted by sparse methods and does not measure errors in their missing regions.
A first Gaussian centre or density peak is not guaranteed to lie on the original mesh surface.
Signed mesh error is a synthetic first-surface proxy after near clipping, not independent real-world ground truth.
Both positive and negative errors beyond30mm are reported; low background leakage alone is not an occlusion pass.
Merged clouds preserve repeated surfaces from multiple views; no fusion or deduplication is performed.
